answer: Rio Tinto explicitly excludes Scope 3 Categories 8, 11, 12, 13, 14 and 15. Category 11 (use of sold products) is treated as not applicable because Rio Tinto does not produce fossil fuels or manufacture products applicable to that category. Categories 8, 12, 13 and 14 are excluded because it has no significant leased-asset or franchise activity and its products/end-use materials are predominantly recycled. Category 15 is excluded as a separate category because the equity-share approach already includes investment emissions in Scope 1, Scope 2 or other applicable Scope 3 categories.
